additional_info.subject: ID0424186-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP/P8 170000883] T2 socket Issue CRM:00798002155
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Customer have reported issue as following :
"The T2 socket moves slightly when mechanically stressed from the outside. The internal retaining screws no longer seem to hold the socket properly."
We need to investigate and check if sealing is proper or not.
Upon investigation if sealant issue we need to consider Replacing Shutter,
if screw thread seems to be worn out, we need to check for the sealing socket bals.
In case if you need additional assistance, Feel free to reach out to us.
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0424186 ﻿from the
